title: Jar Jar Binks
subtitle: Bombad General
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust]: If you gave a token upgrade to a unit this phase, deal 1 damage to a unit and heal 1 damage from a base.
deployBox:
Shielded (When you deploy this leader, give a Shield token to him.)
On Attack: If you gave a token upgrade to a unit this phase, you may deal 1 damage to a unit and heal 1 damage from a base.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Any ability that you control that creates a token upgrade on a unit satisfies the condition of Jar Jar's ability, including Shielded.
Jar Jar’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if you didn't give a token upgrade to a unit this phase (but you don't deal or heal any damage).
